title: 表示层可达性：局部 prototype residual 是否扩大实例 mask 的可达表示空间
question: 在固定 YOLO26m-seg 检测框、类别和候选身份后，局部特征驱动的系数残差与局部 prototype residual 是否能稳定改善实例 mask，且改善是否来自 prototype 表示层而非仅来自系数容量？
hypothesis: R_local_proto_residual 将同时学习局部系数残差和低秩 prototype 残差；若 R 相对 F 仍有可重复的正增益，则支持表示层可达性假设。

arms.name: native_coefficient_capacity
arms.intervention: fine-tune native coefficient heads only; prototype, detector, box and class paths remain frozen

arms.name: local_feature_coefficient_residual
arms.intervention: add Delta-c from a predicted-box ROI of the feature entering each native coefficient head; native prototype and native coefficient heads remain frozen

arms.name: local_proto_residual
arms.intervention: use P(c+Delta-c)+Q Delta-d, with frozen native P and trainable low-rank Q and local Delta-d

data.formal_train_selection: sort train2017 image IDs by SHA256('representation_reachability_train20k_seed0:' + str(image_id)); take first 20000; persist the resulting list in each Run
data.dataset_versions_and_paths: must be resolved and hashed in the Run before execution

execution.primary_checkpoint: final epoch only; no best-checkpoint selection

decision.blocking_observation: G0 preflight and all four arm Smoke Runs passed; formal 20k training is not started and no AP result exists.

limits: A is an inference reference, not a trained arm.
F and R are not claims about a globally optimal prototype basis.
A pilot or engineering screen cannot establish the 20k conclusion.
RUN_REPR_REACH_PREFLIGHT_S0 through R5 contain preserved engineering failures; R7 is the verified G0 pass. No scientific AP result or formal 20k training result exists.
